description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the MergeVideoModelFace operation in the video production (videoenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍视频生产（videoenhan）类目下的模板视频人脸融合MergeVideoModelFace的语法及示例
name: MergeVideoModelFace

parameters.help_en: The template ID of the video face template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the replacement face reference image (required when TemplateId corresponds to a single-face template). FaceImageURL is used only for single-person video scenarios, in which case the MergeInfos field is not required.
Currently, only OSS links in the Shanghai region are supported. For information about how to generate a URL, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

Input limits:
Image format: JPEG, JPG, or PNG.
Image resolution: greater than or equal to 128 × 128 pixels and less than or equal to 4000 × 4000 pixels.
Image size: no greater than 20 MB.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
替换后的人脸参考图像URL地址（TemplateId为单人脸时不可为空）。FaceImageURL仅为单人视频场景时使用，此时无需输入MergeInfos字段。
当前仅支持上海地域的OSS链接，如何生成URL请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

输入限制：
图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG。
图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于4000×4000像素。
图像大小：不大于20 MB。
URL地址不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: face_image_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add a watermark. Valid values:

True (default): Add a watermark.
False: Do not add a watermark
parameters.help_zh:
是否添加水印。取值范围如下：

True（默认）：添加水印。
False：不添加水印
parameters.name: add_watermark

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable face beautification enhancement. Valid values:

False (default): Do not enable face beautification enhancement.
True: Enable face beautification enhancement
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启人脸美颜增强。取值范围如下：

False（默认）：不开启人脸美颜增强。
True：开启人脸美颜增强
parameters.name: enhance

parameters.help_en:
The watermark type. Valid values:

EN (default): English watermark.
CN: Chinese watermark
parameters.help_zh:
水印类型。取值范围如下：

EN（默认）：英文水印。
CN：中文水印
parameters.name: watermark_type

fields.help_en: The image URL of the replacement face for this face. Currently, only OSS links in the Shanghai region are supported. For information about how to generate a URL, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.help_zh: 该人脸待替换的图像URL。当前仅支持上海地域的OSS链接，如何生成URL请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en:
The sub-ID of a specific face in the multi-face template. This must be obtained from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468904.html operation first (when multiple TemplateFaceID values are passed in, they cannot be duplicated).

If both TemplateFaceID and TemplateFaceURL are passed in, TemplateFaceID takes priority
fields.help_zh:
多脸模板对应的某个人脸的子ID。需要先在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468904.html接口中获取（传入多个TemplateFaceID时，不可重复）。

同时传入TemplateFaceID和TemplateFaceURL时，TemplateFaceID优先
fields.name: template_face_id

fields.help_en: The image URL of a specific face in the multi-face template. This allows users to use a third-party detection module to extract frames and perform face recognition to obtain the corresponding face image
fields.help_zh: 多脸模板对应的某个人脸的图像URL。此情况允许用户自己使用第三方检测模块抽帧进行人脸识别后获取相应的人脸图像
fields.name: template_face_url

parameters.help_en:
The fusion parameters, including the face information of the template video and the user face image to be merged (required when TemplateId corresponds to a multi-face template).

MergeInfos is used only for multi-person video scenarios. Make sure that the VideoScene parameter was set to `multi` when the user added the template. The TemplateFaceID values passed in must correspond one-to-one with the TemplateFaceID values in the FaceInfos returned when the template was added.
If both FaceImageURL and MergeInfos are passed in, the system determines which to use based on whether the TemplateId corresponds to a single-face or multi-face template, and filters out the other parameter
parameters.help_zh:
融合参数，模板视频的人脸信息及待融合的用户人脸图片（TemplateId为多人脸时不可为空）。

MergeInfos仅为多人视频场景时使用，需确保用户添加模板时VideoScene参数传入了`multi`值，其中传入的TemplateFaceID需要与添加模版时返回的FaceInfos里的TemplateFaceID一一对应。
同时传入FaceImageURL和MergeInfos，以TemplateId为单/多人脸为准，过滤另一个入参
parameters.name: merge_infos

Data.description_en: The returned result data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159423.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159423.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoURL.description_en:
The URL of the processed video.
This URL is a temporary address that is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes, download the file, and store it in your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoURL.description_zh:
处理后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
